passive.name: Z-Drive Resonance
passive.description: Every third attack or damaging spell on the same target deals bonus magic damage, and grants Ekko a burst of speed if the target is a champion.

spells.name: Timewinder
spells.description: Ekko throws a device dealing magic damage. On hitting a champion or reaching the end of its range, it expands into a field that Slows enemies inside by %. After it expands, Ekko recalls it, dealing magic damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation InitialDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Parallel Convergence
spells.description: Passive: Ekko's Attacks against enemies below % Health deal missing Health magic damage. Active: Ekko launches a chronosphere lasting seconds after a delay that Slows enemies inside by %. If Ekko enters the sphere, he detonates it, Stunning for seconds and gaining Shield.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation MissingHealthPercent was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Phase Dive
spells.description: Ekko dashes and empowers his next Attack to have bonus range, teleport him to his target, and deal an additional magic damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Chronobreak
spells.description: Ekko turns back time, entering Stasis while teleporting to where he was 4 seconds ago and dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. In addition, Ekko restores Health, increased by % for each 1% Health he lost in last 4 seconds.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
